test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff6e1c39726edf0ff766a7caf82436f530de13f1e508dda6603056ff90e03083.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: Sides of first figure : Place outside first figure and + 1 side figure place inside.**

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b2c8c2c4aa1a990b61f889775c4ac29fddfcd6e8330f3065399dbdf948d21d5.png] 

⇒ First figure has 3 sides: The second figure triangle has 3 sides placed outside and a square placed inside have 4 sides.

And,

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54318f9157aa8251b36fcd270d27d0bfd879b641b7ec9f902e0a41d97ea0d350.png] 

⇒ First figure has 4 sides: The second figure square has 4 sides placed outside and the pentagon placed inside has 5 sides.

Similarly,

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c210d24072d3d17b0c04ce9603e30acf3c4b989cea61cfd8a80120d9d5cebe2.png] 

⇒ First figure has 5 sides: The second figure pentagon have 5 sides placed outside and the hexagon placed inside has 6 sides.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
